<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M+2 peak (≈2 Da higher than the base peak) with intensity ~24 % of the base peak, matching the natural abundance of ³⁷Cl relative to ³⁵Cl. No ~1:1 M/M+2 pattern (bromine) or ~4 % M+2 (sulfur) is observed. Thus chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
